verdict.rationale: Riveter's evidence shows it exposes its own MCP server for assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor to connect to. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. Its agents calling third-party APIs is an adjacent capability, and nothing shows users can plug external MCP servers into Riveter so its agents can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
